Hi all - thanks for the note, Alex. Brief answers below and attachments: we've attached our SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and the subprocessor export.

1) SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II. See attached "SOC2-Type2-Report-2026.pdf" and the hosted-report link: https://drive.redwood.com/reports/soc2-2026.

2) Subprocessors and PII access:
- AWS (primary compute & storage) - regions used: us-east-1, us-west-2. All customer content is encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest (AES-256). For the hosted product we use customer tenant isolation and automatic key rotation; for Dedicated/Private customers we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM).
- GCP (embedding index storage for experimental workloads) - used in limited pilot projects; encrypted at rest, access restricted by IAM.
- Datadog, Sentry (monitoring/observability) - logs are redacted by default; no raw customer content is persisted in observability pipelines.
- Stripe (billing) - only sees billing info provided directly by customers; payment data is not correlated with customer content.
- HashiCorp Vault (secrets management) - used for encryption key lifecycle management for Dedicated/Private deployments where customers opt into CMK.

None of the subprocessors have routine access to unencrypted customer PII. Any limited exceptions are controlled (audited access, just-in-time, and logged). If ACME requires additional contractual guarantees (e.g., strict data residency or no cross-border subprocessors), Dedicated or Private deployment is the recommended path.

3) HIPAA / BAA: We offer BAAs for Dedicated and Private deployments; for the hosted product we evaluate on a case-by-case basis and can discuss controls required for a BAA. If ACME needs HIPAA support for the pilot, we should scope a Dedicated environment.

4) Questionnaire & data flow: We will populate the attached "Redwood-Vendor-Questionnaire-ACME.docx" and include a high-level data flow diagram showing processing boundaries and where KV caches and indices are stored. Expect a completed first pass by end of day Friday (2027-04-23).

Next steps:
- Marissa / Aditya: confirm preferred delivery format for the completed questionnaire (Docx vs DocuSign).
- ACME: confirm whether you need a BAA for the pilot or if the initial eval can proceed under standard terms.
- I'll attach the subprocessor CSV if you want the full export.

Thanks,
